## Summary

## Scope and safety

- [ ] I read `AGENTS.md` and relevant narrower instructions.
- [ ] The change contains no real secret or private account data.
- [ ] The change adds no canary/live, withdrawal, transfer, or risk-bypass path.
- [ ] External inputs are schema validated and fail closed.
- [ ] Financial authority boundaries use Decimal and timestamps use aware UTC.
